FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: UrbanNest Realty specializes in providing comprehensive real estate services, focusing primarily on residential property sales and leasing. Our operations encompass connecting buyers with sellers, offering detailed market analyses, and facilitating transactions with an emphasis on transparency and compliance with all relevant real estate regulations. We pride ourselves on our strong risk management protocols and maintain adequate professional liability and errors & omissions insurance to mitigate potential exposures during transactions. Our team is composed of experienced, licensed agents who adhere to the highest standards of ethical practice and fair housing laws, ensuring a positive experience for all clients. We leverage advanced technology for transaction management and client communication, striving for efficiency and security in all dealings. Additionally, we prioritize maintaining enduring relationships with reputable vendors, including title companies and mortgage lenders, to provide our clients with a robust suite of services while ensuring compliance with prevailing legal standards.
